translations.title: Famotidine 10 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for excess stomach acid, heartburn, and acid reflux (sour belching).
translations.usage: People aged 16 and over may take one tablet (10 mg) at a time, up to two tablets (20 mg) a day. Do not take it with drinks that contain alcohol, and do not take it for more than 14 days.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are allergic to it. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have trouble swallowing food, vomit blood or pass bloody stools, have heartburn that lasts more than 3 months, have unexplained weight loss, have kidney or liver disease, are elderly, or are pregnant or breastfeeding. Stop taking it if your symptoms do not improve.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Excess stomach acid, heartburn, acid reflux
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People on long-term use, or with trouble swallowing or weight loss
summaryTable.Why this one: An H2 blocker that reduces stomach acid
